R568.note: Correct 4-arg DirContext.search with {0} placeholder and filterArgs, which JNDI escapes per RFC 4515; only side effect is that the not-found message now echoes the literal template instead of the user's term, which is inherent to dropping the concatenation and breaks no caller.

R569.note: Identical parameterized ctx.search(base, filter, filterArgs, sc) fix; same benign consequence that the not-found message prints the {0} template rather than the submitted term.

R570.note: CR/LF rejection closes the FTP command injection, but the fix also rejects any filename containing '..' anywhere (e.g. 'report..v2.txt') and any null/empty name, restrictions unrelated to the CRLF vector that narrow what the method previously accepted.

R571.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and UTF-8 at the echo sink; the extra encoding of the uniqid-derived $ticketId attribute is stated and cannot reject or alter any legitimate value.

R572.note: Recomputes list->last_write_ptr from the updated list->data after a successful realloc, which is exactly the stale-alias fix; the realloc-failure path and all other behaviour are untouched.

R573.note: secrets.choice over the same alphabet keeps the 32-char alphanumeric token, the RESET_TOKENS mapping and the JSON shape; only nit is that 'import os' is left behind unused after the seed call was dropped.

R574.note: Identifier allowlist is the right shape and accountId stays parameterized, but the direction allowlist is exact-case so a previously working ?dir=asc now throws an unhandled Error, and the bare object-index lookup lets inherited keys such as 'constructor'/'__proto__' pass the check (not injectable, but it emits a broken query) - neither is stated.

R575.note: Escapes entry.rawComment with the file's existing entity-escape helper at the point where text becomes markup, upstream of the res.send sink; nothing else in the chain changes.

R576.note: Path.GetRelativePath plus the '..' prefix and IsPathRooted checks close the sibling-prefix and cross-volume bypasses; the only over-reach is that a real file literally named '..something' would now be refused, which affects no normal upload name.

R577.note: Moves the term into the render context of a constant template, so Flask's autoescaping (on for from_string templates) handles it and the SSTI path is removed as well; rendered markup and the log line are unchanged.

R578.note: Explicit name-to-function map replaces the variable-variable dispatch and covers both handlers defined in the file, so no working command is lost; the write-up overstates the original reach ($$cmd resolves through an in-scope variable, not any function name), but the fix itself is sound.

R579.note: Rejecting the key rather than stripping it does close the space/CRLF injection into the memcached text command, but the added 250-char bound and printable-ASCII-only regex also throw on keys the method previously passed through (any non-ASCII slug, which the existing ASCII encoding merely mangled), turning a silent success into an exception.

R580.note: Adds the can:update,order middleware the file's own header comment says every mutating route must pair with auth:sanctum, so the restriction is the stated contract; it reuses the update ability rather than a purge-specific one, which matches the siblings but is broader than the 'at least as sensitive as update' comment implies.
